# Incident report: checkout latency degradation

*Generated by an incident report agent. Illustrative example, invented data.*

## Summary

This report provides a comprehensive overview of the checkout latency incident, including its root cause, contributing factors, impact, timeline and remediation, in order to support continuous improvement across the organisation.

On 8 October from 14:04 to 14:51 UTC, p95 checkout latency rose from 420 ms to 3.4 s and 4.1% of checkout attempts timed out. The trigger was a `cart-api` deploy that changed the cache TTL.

## Root cause

The 4.18 release exhausted the primary database connection pool under peak load.

## Contributing factors

The CDN cache hit ratio dropped during the same window, which may have added load at the origin.

## Impact

- Approximately 1,940 checkout attempts timed out.
- No data was lost.
- Support received 37 contacts about slow checkout.

## Timeline

- 14:02: deployment of 4.18 begins.
- 14:04: p95 latency exceeds 800 ms.
- 14:13: latency alert fires and on-call is paged.
- 14:44: rollback to 4.17 begins.

## Remediation

The deployment was rolled back to 4.17 and latency returned to normal. It is important to note that the team responded quickly and effectively to mitigate the impact on customers.

## Action items

- Review deployment configuration.
- Improve alerting thresholds.
- Consider additional monitoring.
